q1.sampleAnswer: Because humans have had many lasting influences on the Earth.

keyPoints.descZh: 人类对地球产生了许多持久的影响
examples: humans have had many lasting influences on Earth

q1.rubricZh: 要点：人类对地球有许多持久的影响。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段说这些科学家认为人类对地球造成了很多长久的影响，所以才觉得进入了“人类世”。

evidence.quote: because humans have had many lasting influences on Earth

q2.explanationZh: 第四段说 Autin 觉得“人类世”更像流行文化，不像严格的科学，所以他不支持。

evidence.quote: For Autin, the Anthropocene is more about pop culture than hard science.

q3.sampleAnswer: To remind people that humans are having an undeniable effect on the Earth.

keyPoints.descZh: 提醒人们人类对地球有不可否认的影响
examples: remind people that humans are having an undeniable effect on the Earth

q3.rubricZh: 要点：提醒人们人类对地球有不可否认的影响。
q3.explanationZh: 第五段里 Steffen 说，新名字会提醒大家：人类正在对地球产生不可否认的影响。

evidence.quote: the new name would remind people of the reality

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. Humans have caused serious damage to the environment. The introduction of a new geologic time term can raise awareness of this reality among more people. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 明确表态（支持或不支持）

examples: Humans have caused serious damage to the environment.

q4.rubricZh: 观点题，言之有理即可：表明态度（1分）并给出合理理由（1分）。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题，先说支持还是不支持，再结合文章写一个理由，例如人类已经破坏了环境，新名词能让更多人重视。

evidence.quote: we have caused many plants and animals to go extinct
